frame.name: AppShell
frame.description: Chooses which header, menu and footer a page shows (application form, advisor, error).

frame.name: AppHeader
frame.description: Brand, help actions, application menu, cart and the step bar.

frame.name: AppBody
frame.description: Main content container with responsive spacing.

frame.name: AppFooter
frame.description: Administrator, insurer, support and legal details.

frame.name: ClientHelpBanner
frame.description: Client phone, chat and other support actions.

frame.name: OfflineBanner
frame.description: Connection notice shown above the header.

frame.name: ProgressStep
frame.description: The steps (Getting started, Choose your coverage, and so on) and the breadcrumbs within the current step.

frame.name: FormRoutePage
frame.description: Wraps each consumer form page: title, steps, breadcrumbs, back, help, validation, saving and Next.

frame.name: FormShell
frame.description: The visual surface a form sits on.

frame.name: PageHeader
frame.description: Page title, supporting copy, back action and contextual help.

frame.name: PageTitle
frame.description: Page heading, subtitle and supporting actions.

frame.name: PageNav
frame.description: The page's Next or Submit action.

sections.name: HomeHero
sections.description: Introduction, start and resume actions, with a quote card or association image.

sections.name: AssociationIntroduction
sections.description: Association logo, tagline and introductory paragraphs.

sections.name: HomeCoverageSection
sections.description: Coverage heading, description, category choices and product information.

sections.name: UnderwriterCredentials
sections.description: Insurer logo, name, ratings, description and footnote.

sections.name: MembershipStatus
sections.description: The membership question, with its link, eligibility and non-member feedback.

sections.name: MemberInformation
sections.description: Applicant name, email and phone, collected once membership is confirmed.

sections.name: AdditionalMembershipInformation
sections.description: Conditional membership follow-up questions.

sections.name: MembershipHelp
sections.description: Coverage options and how-applying-works help actions.

sections.name: EligibilitySections
sections.description: Personal information, covered applicants, spouse details and repeated children.

sections.name: CoverageQuestions
sections.description: Category questions with their member and spouse follow-ups.

sections.name: ProductCatalog
sections.description: Product choices with coverage and rider options per applicant, and the combined cost.

sections.name: BeneficiaryProductRecords
sections.description: Beneficiary records per product, with add, edit and remove.

sections.name: ContactSections
sections.description: Lays out the contact sections below.

sections.name: ResidentialAddress
sections.description: Residential address and any mailing-address control.

sections.name: BusinessInformation
sections.description: Business address, with a same-as-home option.

sections.name: SpouseContact
sections.description: Spouse contact details.

sections.name: ProfileSections
sections.description: Personal, employment, financial, existing-coverage, travel, residence and spouse sections, in order.

sections.name: ReviewSections
sections.description: Application summary, legal disclosures and the required consents.

sections.name: PaymentSections
sections.description: Payment elections, banking fields and cost display.

sections.name: HealthInformationHelp
sections.description: Help chip and explanation drawer.

sections.name: HealthQuestionList
sections.description: Questions one at a time, answered separately for member and spouse, with Yes/No answers and follow-up details.

sections.name: ProcessingStatusPage
sections.description: A progress state: loading the externally hosted QuickDecision questions, or the signature in progress.

sections.name: ESignInstructions
sections.description: Tells the applicant what happens next in the electronic-signature process.

sections.name: ReceiptConfirmation
sections.description: Submission confirmation, security notice and document downloads.

sections.name: ReceiptDecisions
sections.description: Decision letters, with the application receipt and help alongside.

sections.name: ReceiptApplicationSummary
sections.description: Summary of the selected coverage and payment instructions.

sections.name: ReceiptNextSteps
sections.description: Acknowledgement with payment and welcome-kit guidance.

sections.name: ResumeEmailRequest
sections.description: Application email address and the action to send a secure link.

sections.name: ResumeDeliveryMethod
sections.description: Choice of Text or Call to receive the verification code.

sections.name: ResumeCodeEntry
sections.description: Verification code entry and the Next action.

sections.name: ExpiringCodeAlert
sections.description: Shows whether a secure link or code is active or expired, and confirms a send or resend.

sections.name: ResendCountdownRow
sections.description: Resend countdown and action.

sections.name: AdvisorLoginTabs
sections.description: Start and Continue tabs, each with its fields and action.

sections.name: ConfirmationAlert
sections.description: Success message that a request was sent.

sections.name: DetailsTable
sections.description: Labeled values with a follow-up action: applicant email, send time and purge date, or the edit request details.

sections.name: ApplicationErrorState
sections.description: The one layout for every error page: icon or number, heading, message, guidance and actions.
